# Northeast AEC — Building Science & Historic Envelope Specifications
> Authoritative technical specifications, cold & coastal building physics, and contractor execution standards for Climate Zones 5 & 6 and 4A Coastal (NY, MA, PA, NJ, CT, RI, VT, NH, ME).

Northeast AEC publishes peer-reviewed architectural and mechanical specifications covering masonry repointing, cold-climate heat pumps, oil conversions, ice dam defense, and historic preservation.

## Technical Specifications (Clean Markdown)
- [Balloon-Frame Firestop Autopsy: Boston Triple-Deckers & Victorians](https://northeastaec.com/articles/balloon-frame-firestop-autopsy-triple-deckers.md): Firestop and weatherize historic Northeast balloon-frame triple-deckers: Halt the 3-story convective chimney, install code-compliant intumescent fireblocks, and dense-pack cellulose.
- [Blower Door Depressurization Testing for Historic Northeast Homes](https://northeastaec.com/articles/blower-door-depressurization-historic-homes.md): Execute code-compliant 50 Pa blower door depressurization testing in older Northeast homes: Diagnostic setup, chemical smoke tracing, and CFM50 leak auditing.
- [Brownstone Facade Restoration: Stopping Salt Spalling & Lintel Decay](https://northeastaec.com/articles/brownstone-facade-restoration-mortar-spalling.md): Restore historic Northeast brownstone rowhouses: Stop freeze-thaw spalling, repair delaminating stone with Jahn M70, and treat rusting steel lintels.
- [How to Pin and Patch Delaminated Brownstone with Jahn M70: Step-by-Step Restoration Protocol](https://northeastaec.com/articles/brownstone-pinning-patching-steps.md): Step-by-step brownstone facade restoration: Learn how historic preservation masons sound delaminated sandstone, drill 45-degree stainless steel dowel pins, and pack breathable Jahn M70 mineral mortar.
- [Taming the Freezing Cape Cod Bedroom: Knee-Wall Air Sealing & Insulation](https://northeastaec.com/articles/cape-cod-kneewall-air-sealing-insulation.md): Air-seal freezing Cape Cod knee walls in Climate Zones 5 and 6: Floor joist blocking, rigid foam air barriers, rafter baffles, and conditioned storage conversions.
- [Step-by-Step Cape Cod Kneewall Air Sealing & Floor Joist Blocking Guide](https://northeastaec.com/articles/cape-cod-kneewall-air-sealing-steps.md): How to air-seal Cape Cod attic kneewalls: Step-by-step instructions for blocking floor joist cavities, sheathing vertical kneewalls, and insulating attic hatch doors.
- [Coastal Cedar Shingle Siding: Freeze-Thaw Defense & Rainscreen WRBs](https://northeastaec.com/articles/cedar-shingle-siding-freeze-thaw-wrb.md): Protect coastal Northeast cedar shingle siding: 3D ventilated rainscreen drainage mats, vapor-permeable self-adhered WRBs, and 316 stainless steel fasteners.
- [Abandoning the Fuel Oil Tank: Cold-Climate Heat Pumps for Northeast Homes](https://northeastaec.com/articles/converting-heating-oil-to-cold-climate-heat-pumps.md): Convert Northeast fuel oil systems to cold-climate inverter heat pumps: Sizing for -15°F design temps, 200A service upgrades, and stacking MassSave and NYSERDA rebates.
- [Dense-Pack Borate Cellulose vs Closed-Cell Spray Foam in Northeast Attics](https://northeastaec.com/articles/dense-pack-borate-cellulose-vs-spray-foam.md): Compare dense-pack borate cellulose to closed-cell spray foam in cold climates: Embodied carbon, low-GWP blowing agents, sub-zero R-values, and wood moisture buffering.
- [Upgrading to a 200A Electrical Panel for Cold-Climate Heat Pumps](https://northeastaec.com/articles/electrical-panel-upgrade-200a-heat-pumps.md): Upgrade older 100-amp electrical panels to 200-amp service for heat pumps: NEC Article 220 load calculations, meter sockets, and smart load management.
- [Restoring Historic Fieldstone Foundations: Why Portland Cement Destroys Stone](https://northeastaec.com/articles/fieldstone-foundation-repointing-lime-mortar.md): Restore historic Northeast fieldstone and rubble basements: Why Portland cement causes spalling and stone fracture, NHL 3.5 lime chemistry, and interior drainage.
- [Step-by-Step Fieldstone Foundation Repointing: Joint Raking & NHL 3.5 Packing Protocol](https://northeastaec.com/articles/fieldstone-repointing-steps.md): How to repoint a historic fieldstone foundation: Step-by-step instructions for raking out failing mortar, pre-wetting stone to SSD condition, and packing NHL 3.5 lime mortar.
- [Historic Wood Window Restoration: Why Vinyl Replacements Are a Mistake](https://northeastaec.com/articles/historic-wood-window-restoration-vs-replacement.md): Restore historic Northeast wood windows: Debunking vinyl replacement sales pitches, old-growth timber durability, bronze weatherstripping, and storm window thermal parity.
- [Retrofitting Cast-Iron Radiators for Low-Temperature Heat Pumps](https://northeastaec.com/articles/hydronic-radiator-low-temp-heat-pump-retrofit.md): Adapt historic Northeast cast-iron radiators to cold-climate air-to-water heat pumps: Thermal surface area sizing, 120°F water loop physics, and hydronic balancing.
- [Ice Dam Mitigation & Nor'easter Defense for Northeast Roof Envelopes](https://northeastaec.com/articles/ice-dam-mitigation-nor-easter-roofing.md): Prevent catastrophic roof ice dams in Climate Zones 5 and 6: Attic air-sealing physics, continuous soffit-to-ridge ventilation, and full-deck ice and water membranes.
- [ICF Basements for 48-Inch Northeast Frost Depths: Structural Thermal Mass](https://northeastaec.com/articles/icf-basements-48-inch-northeast-frost-depth.md): Engineer Insulated Concrete Form (ICF) basements for 48-to-60-inch frost depths in northern New York and New England: Adfreeze frost heave prevention, R-24 thermal mass, and waterproofing.
- [Insulating Historic Brick from the Inside: WUFI Modeling & Smart Vapor Retarders](https://northeastaec.com/articles/interior-masonry-insulation-dew-point-wufi.md): Insulate historic solid brick masonry in Climate Zones 5 and 6: WUFI modeling, avoiding fiberglass mold traps, smart vapor retarders, and protecting embedded timber joists.
- [Low-E Interior Storm Panels vs Whole-Window Replacements: 5 Key Comparisons](https://northeastaec.com/articles/low-e-interior-storm-windows-vs-replacement.md): Compare custom low-E interior storm windows to whole-window replacement: Capital payback timelines, acoustic soundproofing STC 38 ratings, and thermal U-factors.
- [The Homeowner's Guide to MassSave & NYSERDA Electrification Rebates](https://northeastaec.com/articles/masssave-nyserda-electrification-rebate-guide.md): Navigate MassSave and NYSERDA clean heat rebates: Step-by-step qualification, NEEP equipment verification, integrated control mandates, and maximizing incentives.
- [Rural Well Head & Septic Freeze Defense for 54-Inch Frost Depths](https://northeastaec.com/articles/rural-well-head-septic-freeze-prevention-specs.md): Prevent rural well line and septic system freeze-ups in 54-inch frost zones: Pitless adapter depths, 2-inch XPS trench wing insulation, and snowpack thermal buffers.
- [Installing Self-Regulating Heat Trace Cables on Vulnerable Plumbing Runs](https://northeastaec.com/articles/self-regulating-heat-trace-cables-plumbing.md): Install industrial self-regulating heat trace cables on unheated basement and crawlspace pipes: Sizing wattage, electrical GFEP breakers, and elastomeric insulation.
- [Historic Slate Roof Repair & Copper Flashing Restoration](https://northeastaec.com/articles/slate-roof-repair-copper-flashing-restoration.md): Maintain and restore historic Northeast slate roofs: Slate ripper techniques, copper bib and hook replacements, 16-oz soldered flashings, and snow guards.
- [Sub-Slab Drain Tile & Sump Pump Specifications for Historic Cellars](https://northeastaec.com/articles/sub-slab-drain-tile-sump-specs-historic-basements.md): Engineer sub-slab drainage systems for historic Northeast cellars: Trench geometry, crushed washed stone filtration, dimpled wall membranes, and battery backups.
